review.rationale: For this exact fixed schema, Ajv 8.20.0 generates byte-identical validation functions for strict true and strict false; independently compiled functions also agreed on 10,000 seeded generated JSON values. All keywords/types are known and there are no numeric type validators whose strictNumbers behavior could differ. A source edit or Ajv upgrade invalidates this review.

With previous matching the parsed source and concrete YAML sequences, starting at length plus one performs two extra absent-index deletions. YAML 2.9.0 YAMLSeq.delete uses items.splice(index, 1); both extra deletions are no-ops, followed by the original descending deletions. The separate equality guard preserving untouched aliases remains enforced by its regression test.
